summary: Personal statement, professional focus, and core ethos as a 21st-century science educator.
statement: As a licensed professional teacher dedicated to the Special Science Program (STE) and the Philippine MATATAG curriculum, my mission is to nurture critical thinkers who view scientific inquiry not as a set of textbook facts, but as an indispensable tool for community problem-solving and nation-building.
bio: Ramelito Jr. C. Sanchez, LPT (widely known as Jonmiru) is a secondary science teacher and STEM research adviser in the Division of City Schools. With expertise in biological sciences, curriculum localization, and open scientific tooling, he coaches learners in investigative projects spanning environmental science, biotechnology, and robotics. He actively participates in DepEd learning action cells (LAC), instructional material development, and digital literacy advocacy.
